details:
Thanks for checking out this new version of the Graph UI. You can install it using the link below - please do a CLEAN install - close Unity, delete your library and the existing Udon folders (Udon, VRChat Examples and VRCSDK) and then import the new package.
 
There's lots to see! Please take a look and file your findings - bugs, features and suggestions.

Feel free to upload and test things with this SDK, this should all work on Live with the provided SDK. 

Make sure to save your projects separately! New graphs should be mostly backwards-compatible, but no guarantees. The new Comments and Groups will not appear in the old Graph.
 
To open the New Graph, you can find it under VRChat SDK > New Graph or on an UdonBehaviour with the 'Open New Udon Graph' button. You can still access the old graph for now - this will be removed for public release.
Existing Udon bugs will not be any different, this is purely an upgrade to the Graph Window that should make it easier to use, and enable lots of great future upgrades (SubGraphs, etc). We want to test that existing graphs open and compile well with this UI, and that building new graphs works as expected. We're happy to hear about suggested features along with bugs.

SDK Link: https://files.vrchat.cloud/sdk/VRCSDK-UDON-2020.06.04.14.15_Closed_Community_Test.unitypackage
 
What's New:
 
New UI Elements

* Variables are part of a floating window now. You can create, rename and delete them right in this window (they will not show up as nodes). You can drag and drop from the window to your graph to create a 'Get Variable' node or use Search to get Set Variable nodes. We also use a text-matching search function when choosing variable types rather than the long list.
* Groups - create through right-click, drag-and-drop to add items inside.
* Comments - now standalone items created through right-click with adjustable size.

UI Improvements

* Zoom! Just roll your mousewheel!
* Visible Compilation state - check out the box in the upper-right of the graph screen. It will flash green when compiling successfully, and red when unsuccessful. Click on the box to show/hide the latest assembly or errors.
* Ports are easier to connect now
* Copy+Paste Improvements - new nodes appear around mouse
* Welcome screen for messages, known issues and settings
* Right-Click to add Nodes
* Alt+click to drag as well as middle-mouse
* Drag and Drop GameObjects from your Hierarchy to a graph to create a new Public Gameobject variable.
* New StyleSheet system - This is lower-priority, but you will be able to reskin the graph. You can see an example by turning on 'Use Neon Style' in the Settings, this will apply 'UdonGraphNeonStyle.uss' over the existing graph. Do poke around if you're curious. Don't spend time customizing this yet - we're likely to change the names and classes of some elements as part of cleanup so your custom styles will break. We'll let you know when this is locked and add an easy way to apply your own stylesheet.
 
Search
* There's now a few ways to search. Press spacebar to open up Quick Search, which will give you access to a few special commonly used nodes like Events, Debug, UdonBehaviour, as well as the Classes for other nodes like GameObjects, Ints, Networking, etc. If you pick a node from the list, it will appear. If you pick a Class, then you'll get a new search window focused on that class.
* If you want to open up the old full-search, you can do that with Tab - it will be as slow as it used to be, but should work the same.
* If you press space with an existing node selected, you will search within that node's class. So with GameObject Get Name selected, you'll see all the accessible properties and methods for GameObject when you press space. If you don't like this, you can turn it off in Settings ('Focus Search on Selected Node')
